title: Failed at ballot box, now questioning institutions: Rajnath tears into Congress over vote theft charges

ai.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh accused Congress of vote theft claims and undermining democracy after electoral losses, stating the party blames EVMs and election commission instead of addressing its own failures.

facts.claim: Rajnath Singh accused Congress of attempting to undermine India's democratic institutions
facts.quote: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Saturday launched a scathing attack on the Congress and its allies, accusing them of attempting to undermine India's democratic institutions, manufacture political unrest and question the electoral process out of frustration over repeated electoral defeats.

facts.claim: Singh said Congress has failed to form government in several states for decades
facts.quote: There are several states where the Congress has not been able to form a government for decades. They keep failing the electoral test, yet instead of accepting their failures, they blame other political parties

facts.claim: Singh accused Congress of blaming EVMs and election commission for electoral losses
facts.quote: The Congress, however, keeps failing the electoral examination repeatedly

ai.background_note: Rajnath Singh criticized Congress for alleged vote theft claims and shifting blame to electoral machinery instead of addressing internal failures after losing three consecutive Lok Sabha elections.
